note: N-093 / F-098. EmbedTags: readonly tags: FixedArray<bigint,3> = [7,9,11] carries @embedAlways, so all three expanded slots are pushed although unlock reads only tags[1]. unlock(sig, pubKey, amount) requires amount >= tags[1] (= 9), then P2PKH. The near-miss amount 8 proves the slot the script reads is tags[1] and not one of the embedded neighbours (7 would accept 8; 11 would reject 9). Expected verdicts are derived by hand from the source.

spends.note: near-miss: 8 < tags[1]; would ACCEPT if the read slot were tags[0] (7)
10 >= 9; would REJECT if the read slot were tags[2] (11)
